tokens.name: window
tokens.usage: Fallback for the native under-window material behind the whole window, shown when Reduce Transparency is on or off macOS.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Opaque fill of the floating sidebar panel and toolbar capsules when Reduce Transparency is on or off macOS.

tokens.name: glass-panel
tokens.usage: Fill of the floating sidebar panel. It sits over the window material with `blur-panel` and `saturate(180%)`. Text on it is `label` or `label-secondary`.

tokens.name: glass-capsule
tokens.usage: Fill of toolbar capsules, which float over scrolling content with `blur-capsule`. Opaque enough that `label` icons read over any row that scrolls under them.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: 1px edge of glass panels and capsules. Decorative; the fill and shadow carry the shape.

tokens.name: glass-selection
tokens.usage: Selected sidebar item or capsule button while the window is not focused, and the pressed state of capsule buttons. Text on it is `label`.

tokens.name: content
tokens.usage: Content panes: tables, lists, the SKILL.md editor, the sync preview.

tokens.name: row-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating table rows on `content`.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Push button and segmented control fill.

tokens.name: control-pressed
tokens.usage: Push button and segment fill while pressed.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Text field and checkbox borders. Meets 3:1 on `content` and `window`.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, panes and toolbar. Decorative only, never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text on `window`, `sidebar`, `content`, `row-alt`, `control` and every glass surface.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text, column headers, counts and placeholders on `window`, `sidebar`, `content`, `row-alt` and `glass-panel`.

tokens.name: label-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled checkbox borders and field text only. Exempt from contrast rules; never use it for readable text. Disabled buttons use 50% opacity instead.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Claude coral. Links, the focus ring and selected glyphs on `window`, `sidebar` and `content`.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Claude coral fill: primary button, checked checkbox and focused selected row. Text on it is `on-accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `accent-fill`.

tokens.name: selection-inactive
tokens.usage: Selected table row while the window or list is not focused. Text on it is `label`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px solid at 1px offset.

tokens.name: status-linked
tokens.usage: Linked or copied and up to date. Glyph ● with the word Linked or Copied, on `content` and `row-alt`. Blue, so it never reads as the coral selection or as a warning.

tokens.name: status-change
tokens.usage: A planned change: will add, will update, will remove. Glyphs ○ ◐ − with their word, on `content`, `row-alt` and `change-tint`. Amber, set apart from the coral accent.

tokens.name: status-conflict
tokens.usage: Conflict, blocked or broken. Glyphs ✗ and ! with their word, on `content`, `row-alt` and `conflict-tint`.

tokens.name: status-unmanaged
tokens.usage: A skill the user placed that gandalf does not manage. Glyph ? with Not managed, on `content` and `row-alt`.

tokens.name: conflict-tint
tokens.usage: Banner and row background for a conflict. Text on it is `label`; glyph is `status-conflict`.

tokens.name: change-tint
tokens.usage: Banner background for pending changes. Text on it is `label`; glyph is `status-change`.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Added line background in the adopt diff. Text on it is `label`.

tokens.name: diff-remove
tokens.usage: Removed line background in the adopt diff. Text on it is `label`.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Skill name in the detail pane.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Group headers in the sync preview and Discover.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Window title and emphasized row text.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text for rows, controls and paragraphs.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: Read by Codex and GitHub Copilot
styles.usage: Supporting text under a row title.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.usage: Sidebar section headers and table column headers, uppercase.

styles.name: path
styles.usage: Paths, hashes, git URLs and refs.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: SKILL.md editor and the adopt diff.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its word; inside segmented controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between groups in a toolbar or form; sidebar item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Banner and sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Window content margin, the macOS standard.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between sections in the detail pane.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, count badges, diff hunks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text fields, sidebar items, table row selection.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The floating sidebar panel, banners, sheets and popovers. Concentric with the 17pt window corner at an 8px inset.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Push buttons, segmented controls and toolbar capsules, which are all capsule-shaped.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Push buttons and segmented controls.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass panels and capsules: a soft drop shadow plus a 1px top highlight.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and sheets.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Regular push buttons, fields and segmented controls.

tokens.name: control-height-small
tokens.usage: Small controls inside table rows.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Library matrix, change list and sidebar rows.

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: The toolbar band at the top of the content. Capsules center in it, and content scrolls under it.

tokens.name: capsule-height
tokens.usage: Toolbar capsules. Icon buttons inside them are 28px circles.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Floating sidebar panel width; resizable 180 to 300.

tokens.name: glass-inset
tokens.usage: Gap between the window edge and the floating sidebar panel on the top, left and bottom.

tokens.name: blur-panel
tokens.usage: `backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(180%)` on the sidebar panel.

tokens.name: blur-capsule
tokens.usage: `backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%)` on toolbar capsules.
